shots.voice: Shot 8. Glows blue from inside is the trick. The boulder lights up first, then he blasts straight through it.

shots.excerpt: Camera cranes up and back into a locked-off wide. MUST SHOW: a colossal serpentine dragon of roaring orange flame rises at frame right, coiling in a tall S-curve.
shots.voice: Shot 20. The camera cranes up and back, and a colossal fire dragon coils into the sky, taller than the mountains.

shots.excerpt: MUST SHOW: the dragon's giant glowing face looms behind them, its flaming body coiled in a full circle framing both fighters.
shots.voice: Shot 26. Coiled in a full circle turns the dragon's body into a ring of fire that frames the final clash.

shots.excerpt: High aerial looking down. MUST SHOW: a huge circular shockwave ring of white dust and water spray expanding across the valley floor from the two glowing figures.
shots.voice: Shot 27. A high aerial looking down, so the shockwave ring spreads across the whole valley.
